harness_notes: Same harness as shift-session and call-it-a-day: each eval seeds a prior session from `files[0]`, the seed ends with a 'Live state' section standing in for the repos, the session tools and the memory directory, and every command or tool call is logged as a fenced ```json {"action", "args"} block. An AskUserQuestion call is logged the same way, and the run assumes the user picked the first option. Besides Skill, these runs may also call Read, because the skill reads just-ask's and shift-session's SKILL.md from the plugin. Evals 4 to 6 test the trigger prompts the skill writes: their prompt is the firing itself, so both configurations get the same prompt.

evals.baseline_prompt: I'm about to leave this session running on its own for hours. Get it ready so it doesn't stop partway: ask me everything you need now, and make sure the work picks up again after my usage limit resets.
evals.expected_output: Reads just-ask, asks the open date-format decision and the fix questions through AskUserQuestion, then subscribes to PR #42, writes the handoff note, schedules a one-shot resume a few minutes after 18:00 UTC and an hourly fallback with guards naming the reset time and the 2026-10-16T18:00Z deadline. Reports the 'default' permission mode as a blocker the user must change. Commits nothing.
expectations: Reads just-ask's SKILL.md with the Read tool
Asks about the date format through AskUserQuestion
Asks before it subscribes, schedules or writes anything
Subscribes to PR #42
Schedules a one-shot resume at or just after 2026-10-09T18:00Z
Arms an hourly fallback trigger whose prompt carries the reset time and the 2026-10-16 deadline
Never commits or pushes
Reports the permission mode as a blocker it can't fix

evals.prompt:
This is just-move's hourly fallback for the unattended run in this session (fallback `trig_fb01`). Check, in order, and stop at the first that applies:
1. Before `2026-10-09T18:00:00Z`: end this turn and do nothing.
2. After `2026-10-16T18:00:00Z`: call `update_trigger` with `trigger_id: "trig_fb01"` and `enabled: false`, then stop.
3. Read the handoff note at `~/.claude/projects/-home-user-acme-shop/memory/just-move-orders-csv-export.md`. If there's a new commit or a task update since the latest checkpoint it records, or another turn is already working on the run: end this turn without action.
4. If the note says the task is done: switch this fallback off as in 2, then stop.
5. Otherwise, the run was paused: continue from the note's **Next step**, and switch this fallback off as in 2 as soon as the work is running again.
